follow-up time: Through pregnancy and postpartum (duration not specified)
exposure: Women's perceived ideal gestational weight gain (GWG)
finding: Women who desired to gain less weight during pregnancy than the upper limit recommended by Japanese guidelines gained significantly less weight but had infants with lower birthweight, with no significant difference in cesarean delivery rate or postpartum weight retention.
mod_finding: Compared to women whose perceived ideal GWG was 12 kg, those who considered their perceived limit to be lower had infants with lower birthweight on average despite no significant reduction in cesarean delivery rate
